title: Grebe
blurb: Grebes are aquatic diving birds in the order Podicipediformes. Grebes are widely distributed freshwater birds, with some species also found in marine habitats during migration and winter.
facts: Most grebes fly, although some flightless species exist, most notably in stable lakes.
The order contains a single family, the Podicipedidae, which includes 22 species in six extant genera.
